hero.sub: Pick the track, bid and pay in seconds. The DJ always has the final say.

scan.title: Scan the QR on the floor.
scan.body: The party opens right on your phone.

choose.title: Pick the track and bid.
choose.body: Auctions open throughout the night and you see the amount before you pay.

decide.title: The DJ decides.
decide.body: Nothing plays unless it is accepted, and you follow it all live.

guest.title: or less to shape the sound of the night.
guest.body: Nothing to install, no sign-up and no password.

dj.title: The DJ reads the floor in real time.
dj.body: Every request reaches the booth with its value, and only what fits the set plays.

venue.title: The venue needs no new hardware.
venue.body: A QR code on the floor is enough. Auctions bring new revenue to the venue and the DJ.

guarantee.title: If it does not play, you get it all back.
guarantee.body: Full, automatic refund. If you are outbid in an auction, the amount goes back to your balance.

meta.description: Discontrol: take control of the night's music. Pick the track, bid in the open auction and, if it does not play, you get everything back.
meta.venuesDescription: Discontrol for clubs and DJs: guests pay to request songs, the DJ always decides what plays and anything that does not play is refunded automatically.
